crag.name: Allarp
crag.access_info:
❗️IMPORTANT GENERAL INFO❗️

🤫 Keep a low profile.
🗑 Remove all of your trash!
🧹 Brush off tickmarks and excessive chalk!

❗️IMPORTANT INFO FOR SECTOR—ÄNGLAVAKT❗️

⛔️ BIRD RESTRICTIONS: from 1st april to 15th july avoid climbing in this sector.
⛔️ Always access the sector from the north side – away from the houses.
⛔️ The house owners are not exactly huge climbing fans, however all the blocs are on common land so they can't tell you off (even though they probably will). Despite this please be respectful and keep a very low profile.
🚫 Do not climb on the blocs closest to the houses (not featured in the topo).

PARKING
• All parkings are marked on the map. Some may only fit one car.

APPROACH
• Follow the GPS trails on the map.

routes.name: OBS! Do not climb on the slab facing the house!
Kistspik
routes.info: Sitstart on the stone on the ground, with both hands on diagonal crimp rail.
